description: This file is a Bash script that provides a command-line utility to list tmux sessions associated with specified sockets or socket directories. It includes functions for parsing command-line options, listing sessions, handling errors, and filtering sessions based on user input.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: list_sessions
methods.description: Lists tmux sessions for a given socket label, applying filtering based on the query term.
